channel.title: Dumb Game Lab Blog
channel.description: Korean everyday places, cozy idle tycoons, and notes from a tiny game studio in Seoul.

item.title: One Alarm Used 5 Million Rows of the Daily Read Limit on Its Own: Tracing Durable Objects Error 1101
item.description: One alarm in my game server read 4.98 million rows of the free Durable Objects limit (5 million rows read per day), and my error collector went down with error 1101 too. Here is how I traced it and fixed it with indexes, a cache, and monitoring.

item.title: There's No Cat in Catgut
item.description: Despite its name, catgut has never been documented as made from cats. It came mostly from sheep or goat intestines, and some players still use it.

item.title: I Got the Same Feedback 20 Times. Writing Rules Twice Changed Nothing
item.description: Every time I showed a game screen, the feedback was "this looks rushed." Writing rules twice didn't help, so I changed the order: score it side by side with the reference screen before anyone sees it. Here is the log.

item.title: Yesterday Island and Tomorrow Island Are Under 4 km Apart
item.description: Russia's Big Diomede and the US's Little Diomede are 3.8 km apart, yet the date line runs between them and clocks differ by 21 hours.

item.title: Offline Tycoon Games for Phones: Picked by What the Store Page Says
item.description: Want a tycoon game that works with no Wi-Fi or in airplane mode? Check the store description first. We read 12 of them and sorted them into says offline, needs internet and says nothing.

item.title: The Olympics Once Gave Gold Medals for Poems and Paintings
item.description: From 1912 to 1948 the Olympics held art competitions, and Coubertin won the 1912 literature gold with a poem entered under pseudonyms.

item.title: What is a tycoon game? You are not collecting money, you are growing a shop
item.description: A tycoon game is a management game where you build up a shop or business and earn money. Where the word tycoon comes from (Japanese taikun), how Railroad Tycoon in 1990 set the genre, and how it differs from Roblox tycoons, shown on game screens.

item.title: A Month in Space Makes You 2.5 cm Taller
item.description: After about a month in weightlessness, height increases by roughly 2.5 cm, and tears cannot flow but ball up instead.

item.title: 40 Minutes to Check One Fix, and the 5 Second Path Was There All Along
item.description: Checking one bug fix took a 40 minute full build, but a scripts-only build that just compiles the script DLL finished in 5 seconds. Here is why we now set up the fast path first, and the dev mode switch that goes with it.

item.title: In Space, Metal Just Sticks to Metal
item.description: In a vacuum, clean surfaces of the same metal can bond on contact without any heat. Spacecraft designers have to watch out for it.

item.title: What a "Doesn't Fit My Phone" Review Told Us About Android 15
item.description: A dev log that started with a 1-star review saying the game did not fit the phone. Why Android 15 edge-to-edge pushed the bottom tab bar under the navigation bar, the Capacitor adjustMarginsForEdgeToEdge setting we turned on, and why we deleted our 24px patch.

item.title: The BBC Once Said Spaghetti Grows on Trees
item.description: On April Fools' Day 1957 the BBC aired a report of a Swiss family harvesting spaghetti from trees, and hundreds of viewers asked how to grow their own.

item.title: Landing at midnight? Where to sleep in a Seoul jjimjilbang
item.description: Landing in Seoul or at Incheon Airport at midnight? We compared the 24-hour jjimjilbang (Korean spa) where you can sleep overnight. Night rates start at 8 p.m. at most places and 10 p.m. at one. Surcharges, no re-entry, passports and the under-19 rule at 10 p.m. are all checked as of 2026-11-04.

item.title: Crows Remember Your Face and Spread the Word
item.description: Crows recognize individual human faces and are known to spread word of dangerous people with their calls.

item.title: How We Built the Customer AI in PC Cafe Tycoon
item.description: How the customer AI works in a solo-dev PC bang tycoon game. A* with a cost of 12 for tiles where a person stands, one customer per tile, a single queue outside the door, and why we count the customers we turn away, with measured numbers.

item.title: In Space, Candle Flames Are Round
item.description: In space, hot air doesn't rise, so a candle flame burns round and blue.

item.title: PC Bang in Seoul: How Foreigners Can Use One
item.description: Foreigners can use a Seoul PC bang (Korean internet cafe) as a kiosk "Guest" with no Korean phone number. Hourly prices of 1,000 to 2,000 won, overnight packages, payment, the 22:00 minors rule and Korean-server account problems, with sources.

item.title: The People Who See 16 Sunrises a Day
item.description: The space station goes around Earth every 93 minutes, so the people on board see 15 to 16 sunrises a day.

item.title: Internet Cafe Simulator Games in 2026: 17 Picks, iPhone Included
item.description: Looking for an internet cafe simulator on iPhone, Android or Steam? We compared 17 games using prices, ratings and offline notes read straight off the store pages, plus our own game's weak spots.

item.title: The World's Shortest Flight Is Over in a Minute
item.description: The flight between Westray and Papa Westray in the Orkney Islands covers 2.7 km and takes just over a minute.

item.title: Why PC Bangs and Jjimjilbangs Work So Well as Cozy Management Games
item.description: Korea had 11,801 PC bangs in 2019 and 6,658 in April 2026. Public bathhouses fell from a peak of about 10,000 to 5,991. Here is why vanishing neighborhood places suit tycoon games, with screens from my own games.

item.title: On Venus, the Sun Rises in the West
item.description: Venus spins backward, so the sun rises in the west, and one spin takes longer than 1 year.

item.title: Games Like Kairosoft: 8 Games After Cafeteria Nipponica, Relaunched in Airplane Mode
item.description: Eight mobile games to try after the Cafeteria Nipponica trial, each relaunched in airplane mode on a Galaxy Z Flip5. Checked October 30, 2026.

item.title: Games like Egg Inc: nine idle games we launched in airplane mode
item.description: 9 idle games like Egg Inc, each launched in airplane mode on a real phone. Install size and the Play Offline label checked on Oct 30, 2026.

item.title: How we check the games in our comparison lists
item.description: How Dumb Game Lab checks games before writing a games-like list: install on a real phone, measure size, launch in airplane mode, and show only screenshots we took ourselves.

item.title: My daily revenue fell to a thirtieth: 92% of 14 days of income was one article
item.description: A solo dev split mobile game revenue by game and found out why. Of $260 earned in 14 days, $241 came from one game, mostly from traffic that one Taiwanese article created. Here is where I misread it.

item.title: Olympic Gold Medals Are Mostly Silver
item.description: An Olympic gold medal is silver coated with 6 g of gold.

item.title: In a Korean spa tycoon game, where you place things decides your income more than what you buy
item.description: Where do you place things in a Korean spa game to earn 20% more, and where do you lose 20%? The adjacency multiplier table, air conditioner range and door position from the game's real values.

item.title: We Almost Answered the Phone With Ahoy
item.description: Bell wanted ahoy as the phone greeting, but Edison's hello caught on.

item.title: Why Korean PC bangs started selling food like restaurants, not just game time
item.description: Why do Korean PC bangs sell ramen, fried rice and chicken? The 2013 smoking ban, the 2010 food-snitch crackdown, and food sales going from about 10% to 40%, with sources.
